<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> (play on <he>משכני</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4">ib.</cite>) [read:] <he>מַסְכְּנֵינִי אחריך נרוצה</he> make me (Israel) poor, and we shall run after thee (v. <cite ref="M01948">preced.</cite>).

senses.gloss: to become poor. Sot. l. c. כל העוסק בבנין מִתְמַסְכֵּן whoever makes building his business will get poor; Yeb. 63ᵃ; Ex. R. l. c.; Yalk. Ex. l. c.
